Nora (People Ops): Quick notice: we've opened a weekend "late window" for SOC2/ISO evidence uploads — Saturday & Sunday 8am-11:59pm PT. This is strictly for final fixes and uploads only.
Janet (Eng): Awesome, thanks. Is the manifest still required for late uploads?
Isha (Compliance): Yes — manifest.csv required. For late-window uploads mark the manifest header with LATE_WINDOW=true. That helps reviewers prioritize.
Tomo (Security): Reminder: any log artifacts must include timezone-aware timestamps (ISO 8601). If you paste JSON logs, please gzip them and include a README.txt describing the extraction query.
Nora (People Ops): Upload link: https://files.redwood.example.com/weekend-evidence (SSO). If you get permission errors, reply here and we'll escalate.
Janet (Eng): Small ask: we have several screenshots in a repo. Is a zipped repo acceptable?
Isha (Compliance): Zipped repo OK if it contains an index.pdf with page numbers and a short mapping file mapping pages -> controls.
UploadBot: Reminder: Late window active Saturday 08:00 PT. Please include manifest.csv for bulk uploads.
Janet (Eng): One urgent: contractor A's NDA is missing. Do we mark as exception and upload what we have?
Isha (Compliance): Mark as contractor-exception in manifest and add approver name + email. Apply for exception before midnight PT, otherwise artifact will be flagged.
Tomo (Security): Also, redaction notes must include the redactor and approver. Auditors expect an authorization trail.
Nora (People Ops): We're running two late-window office hours Sat 11am PT and Sun 5pm PT for any triage. Drop in if you want a quick sanity check.
Janet (Eng): Uploading 5 files now (manifest included). Will re-upload if we get feedback.
UploadBot: Upload detected from janet. Items: 5. Manifest present.
Isha (Compliance): Received, starting expedited review. We'll DM if pieces need rework.
Nora (People Ops): Final note: teams that miss the late window will be given a single-day extension only for documented emergency cases. Please plan accordingly. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tomo (Security): Thanks all — if anyone needs help generating time-zone aware exports from Kibana let me know; I can share a small script.
Janet (Eng): Thanks everyone, appreciated the flexibility.
